claims.statement: Primary newsprint in the San Francisco Daily Evening Bulletin attests plural 'Hoodlums' on 14 December 1866.
claims.rationale: Direct visual inspection of the primary archival page image verifies printed date and word sense.

evidence_boundary.establishes: Documented print usage at the stated date and venue.
evidence_boundary.does_not_establish: Ultimate pre-print oral coinage or donor-language etymology.
evidence_boundary.remaining_uncertainty: Undigitized ephemeral print prior to 1866 remains unsearched.

limitations: Bounded by surviving digitized San Francisco police-court newspaper runs.
